The '''Market Station''' was a [[Hovertrain/Legends|hovertram]] station located in the [[Old World]] of the planet [[Zakuul]] that originally served the [[Tram Market]]. However, the station was closed down at some point and was incorporated into the market nearby. The abandoned trams were reconverted into shops.<ref name="KotFE 7" />

In [[3631 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_updates">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> during the [[War against Zakuul]], [[Senya Tirall]] and the [[Alliance Commander]] questioned the [[Information broker/Legends|Information broker]] [[Mona Gale]] at Market Stationt during their search for the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]].<ref name="KotFE 7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Market Station appears as a location on Zakuul in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion.<ref name="KotFE 7" />
